name: AI CKEditor WCAG
description: Adds a plugin for CKEditor 5 to let editors prompt AI for checking WCAG compatibility.
project_description:
AI CKEditor WCAG adds a single AI CKEditor action plugin for CKEditor 5 that lets editors prompt an AI model to check the selected text for WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) compatibility. It extends the drupal/ai and ai_ckeditor modules: the editor selects text, opens the AI Assistant, chooses WCAG, and clicks "Check the selected text"; the AI feedback streams back into a text-format response field inside the editor dialog.

The plugin (Drupal\ai_ckeditor_wcag\Plugin\AICKEditor\WCAG) builds a prompt of the form "Check if the content of the following text is in line with WCAG version <v> level <l> rules: <selected text>" and dispatches it through the parent ai_ckeditor request pipeline to the configured chat provider. The target WCAG version (1.0/2.0/2.1/2.2) and conformance level (A/AA/AAA) are chosen per text-format plugin configuration.

Key features:
- WCAG-compatibility check action inside CKEditor 5.
- Selectable WCAG version and conformance level.
- Per-plugin AI provider/model selection (or the AI module chat default).
- Responses returned in the same language as the checked text.

Requirements: core ckeditor5, the AI module (ai), and its ai_ckeditor submodule. Checks run through the configured AI provider and incur provider usage cost. This is an advisory tool, not an automated accessibility fixer or audit.
